checks.details: 389 checks passed: 9 Mac static, 22 PC graphics, 22 FidelityFX, 29 graphics, 115 interface settings and 192 runtime. Compact flat-pad, obstacle-patch and smooth-slope fixtures. Metadata captured before verification; subsequent production edits only corrected comments, test wording and documentation, with no executable behavior change.

22 native D3D12 assertions passed on custom Godot 4.7.2 and RX 9070. Auto uses FSR 4.1.1, temporal viewport and no MSAA; bilinear uses spatial scaling with MSAA 2x, including when saved frame generation is requested. No SDK errors, actual frame generation off. Matched fixed-camera 1280x720 mixed-map stills inspected at 75 percent internal: composition preserved, spatial image softer and more jagged. Settings option rendered. 384 trees and 48 rocks, capped 60, no FPS claim. Initial capture used an invalid default camera and was rejected; corrected harness reran the same assertions and replaced its own three captures.
